Episode 227. A New Enemy, Enemies of Enemies(1)
"It's almost certain that Bisekhs teamed up with Runcandel."
Kellick Zifel walked into Ragal's office in Dokmaseong and said that. He had just returned from receiving a report about Ann after meeting Mu, who had just arrived from the Infernal Realm.
"Almost certain... it's a bit disappointing information for what we've lost Siker to obtain."

"Ann died once. But since the time to lose her physical body was too short, she must have been struck by someone other than Baekgyeong. Baekgyeong could never deal with Ann, who had been so miserably beaten, at once."
"Is that the opinion of your person?"
Your person.
Ragal had never met 'Ganestoga', including Joshua. Of course, he had tortured them when they were prisoners, but only Kellick had contact with Ganestoga since they awakened and went to Lokia's world.
"Yes. He's someone who knows Baekgyeong very well, so his words must be correct. Even considering Baekgyeong, whom I personally experienced in the past, it's impossible."
"Baekgyeong followed Siron Runcandel and went to the Black Sea. Is there a possibility that he has become a person without blood or tears, like a monster?"

"If that were the case, Siron would not have let Baekgyeong return. From the start, there was no such part in the information about Baekgyeong reported to the Infernal Realm so far. It seems that my words 'almost certain' are stuck, but it's okay to recognize the cooperation between Bisekhs and Runcandel as certain, Ragal."
"That's a relief. Siker, he was a good guy, though."
Kellick sat down and spread the grimoire.
Ragal coughed subtly, watching his atmosphere.
"Hem-hem! But Kellick, my friend, the people you just met. Can't you introduce me to them?"
"It's not that stage yet."
"Oh, is it because you can't trust me yet?"
"Of course it is."

"No... I have no intention of betraying you at all. You know, my situation. If I expose you to Jito, my neck will be cut off first, and frankly, it seems impossible to connect with other demon kings and kick you."
Kellick met Ragal's eyes and smiled significantly.
"The reason I can't fully trust you, Ragal, is not because of that."
"Then why...?"
"It's because you still don't know yourself."
"I don't know myself? What do you mean by that, my friend Kellick?"
"You will gradually understand what I mean. By any chance, do you feel that your mind is becoming clearer these days while spending time with me?"
Ragal took a moment to reflect on recent events. As Kellick said, it seemed like his brain was rapidly improving after meeting him.

"Well, it seems so. Certainly... I have greatly reduced instances of getting excited, laughing nervously, or acting rashly than before. At the same time, I feel like I should appear the same as usual to Lord Jito, so even if he occasionally calls me, I intentionally act more foolish."
The reason for Ragal's transformation was none other than brainwashing.

As Tyllias had explained to Jin, most of Jito's subordinates were currently in a brainwashed state due to torture. As a result, even among high-ranking demons, the majority were not fully mentally or physically capable.
This was also the reason why the combat power of most demon kings was significantly lower compared to the top superhumans.
Ragal himself was not aware, but the brainwashing started to fade slightly after meeting Kellick.
The brainwashing could never be completely undone until Jito's death, but even this was a significant change for Ragal.

".....Ho-ho! Suddenly, I feel intrigued. How did this happen? Is this also something that started thanks to you, my friend Kellick? I just knew that I felt unusually refreshed when I woke up these days."
"When you fully understand yourself, it will be appropriate for you to meet my people."
Ragal saw Kellick with newfound admiration.
Not much time had passed since Kellick revealed his true colors, but Ragal was sincerely amazed at the capabilities he had shown so far.
Of course, it was unthinkable for Ragal that Bisekhs had a spy in Dokmaseong and that Bisekhs would be connected to the human world.

The same was true for the act of smuggling prisoners out of the underground prison, and for Kellick secretly communicating with 'some kind of power' in the Infernal Realm, just as he had done just now.

'I guess it's possible because he has a witch behind him, but this guy, Kellick... the more I see him, the harder it is to take him lightly. It seems like he has some tremendous ambition. Could it be that he will surpass Lord Jito in the future... I think it's possible to that extent.'

Until now, the desire for recognition in the brainwashed Ragal was solely towards Jito. Receiving more recognition from Jito, surpassing Paelito, and gaining the respect of all other demon kings was Ragal's long-held dream.
However, recently, Ragal had a strong desire to be recognized by Kellick as much as by Jito.

"Hmm! If that's the case, this cutie, Ragal, will have to work harder. Anyway, friend, recently the Demon Kings have been falling too often. The loss of Sikere this time might even draw investigations from Jito, the Haitaga family, and the Secretary-General."
"Jito probably won't look this way because of me, and I will meet Haitaga this time."
"Oh, you mean you're going to swallow Haitaga as well? Like you did with me."
"If Sikere's deputy is more receptive than you were at first, there would be no need to go that far. You had quite a hard time with me."
"It was awful... Honestly, after I sent Elona to the sickbed, I was full of confidence, so it was a shock. Now, I know that I was only able to do that to Elona because of the hostages."

Just like Ragal was regaining his intelligence and abilities, it would be the same for the demons of Haitaga if they became Kelliac's minions. In Ragal's opinion, if that happened, someone far stronger and superior than the deceased Sikere would emerge from the demon king-class demons of Haitaga.
"Come to think of it, I have a feeling that you might take over the demon world in this way?"
"As I mentioned before, my ultimate goal is to restore my family."
"So naturally, taking over the demon world is necessary for that process?"

"You're still curious. Don't worry about losing a Demon King. The battle at the barrier is at its peak, so the Secretary-General won't have the capacity to come and question you about Sikere's issue. Drugar Kileth survived too. And above all, even though many Demon Kings have died, the total combat power of the demon world is actually increasing."
"Thanks to the souls you resurrected with your people?"
"Already, you have found five useful souls from Ziphil... It was fortunate to meet a friend, right?"
A statement Ragal made not long after receiving Kelliac from Jito.
Whether then or now, when the roles have reversed, Kelliac was still searching for 'useful souls' in hell.
And among the souls he collected, there were ones who were not from Ziphil. A character like Kidad Hole of Yeokcheon was representative.
"That's right, Ragal."
"Uh, I'm concerned whether Jito is aware of the witches and tacitly consents, or really doesn't know about their existence. But are they really much stronger than the dead Demon Kings?"
"They, too, once ruled the mortal realm or were especially worshipped. They are far superior to the Demon Kings who have not originally been in place."

"It's going quite interestingly... Anyway, what's next? Now that the alliance between Biseops and Runcandle has been confirmed, what do we do? Do we spread false information to the Biseops spy while making Luna
Runcandle face her brothers directly?"

"No. Anne hasn't awakened yet, so I haven't heard the details, but she must have used her power before she lost her physical body. So, whoever killed Anne, the information about it must have been reported to the Barmel Alliance, and Baekgyeong will no longer hesitate to cut down his brothers who are in Hell."
"Then it will be difficult to wear down Baekgyeong's mind using our brothers."

"We should wait for a while, interacting with the families of the same clan as Haitaga. While Zito's forces and the Barmel Alliance are fighting, we just need to watch the process of both sides getting tired. However, there is one thing you might like."
"Oh, something I would like! What is it?"
"I need to make one of the Demon Kings of the Belgashium family my own."
Ragal's pupils dilated.
"You can't be talking about Paelito... So, are you talking about Leila Belgashium?"
"Yes. Leila Belgashium. She has a power close to creation, even though she doesn't know herself, like you. I plan to make her confront Baekgyeong in the future."

"Oh... Leila is currently executing a secret order from Lord Zito. And, though I hate to admit it, Leila is much stronger than I am. Of course, you could crush Leila anytime you want, but you have to try to know the length and short of it, right?"
"Sometimes you can clearly know something without necessarily having to confirm it. But I don't intend to fight with Leila Belgashium. Just a few conversations, and she will betray Zito and join me."
Ragal couldn't quite imagine Leila, who is naive and haughty, doing that, but he nodded.
"If you say so, then it must be. But I don't know what part of it I would like, even though the content is good."
"If Leila joins me, you will have a higher rank than her. Isn't that a good thing?"
Ragal burst into laughter.
"Of course...! Only my friend takes care of me like this!"
"Send an invitation to Leila. She won't be able to refuse if we tell her we have information about Zito's secret order."
"So, you even knew the contents of that secret order. That's creepy... Okay, I'll call Leila right away. Kekeke, when she's under me, I'll pay back all the insults she gave me, Leila."
Ragal began to write an invitation, and Kelliac closed the magic book and sank into thought for a moment.
It was about Mew Ganesto, who he had just met. According to what he saw with his 'insight' while talking with her, she was hiding something from him.

'If the Ganestos already have something to hide from me... Could it be information about the dragons I abandoned in the past? I'll have to check it properly when I meet Ran Ganesto or Bego Ganesto next time. It's burdensome to use insight against Joshua.'
